{
  "implementation": "def solve(case):
    p = case['payload']
    matrix = p['matrix']
    idf = p['idf']
    vector = p['vector']
    m = len(matrix)
    n = len(idf)
    scaled = [[row[j] * idf[j] for j in range(n)] for row in matrix]
    eps = 1e-12
    degrees = [max(sum(x*x for x in row), eps) for row in scaled]
    inv_sqrt = [1.0 / (d**0.5) for d in degrees]
    t = [0.0] * n
    for i in range(m):
        s = inv_sqrt[i]
        vi = vector[i]
        row = scaled[i]
        for j in range(n):
            t[j] += row[j] * s * vi
    result = [0.0] * m
    for i in range(m):
        s = inv_sqrt[i]
        row = scaled[i]
        total = 0.0
        for j in range(n):
            total += row[j] * s * t[j]
        result[i] = total
    result_rounded = [round(v, 8) for v in result]
    degrees_rounded = [round(d, 8) for d in degrees]
    return {'result': result_rounded, 'degrees': degrees_rounded}"
}
